name: bloom-pomodoro
description: Bloom — a cozy pixel-pal pomodoro app

scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=bloom-pomodoro
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run cap:sync && node scripts/build-apk.mjs assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run cap:sync && node scripts/build-apk.mjs assembleRelease
